Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews: Extremely slow service. More than 30min wait at non-peak

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews:
这家是被《米其林指南》必比登推荐的虾面店
今天这顿真的被我挖到宝了！！人均不到20💰直接吃到满足到扶墙走 🤤
点了这些：
🍜 炒大虾白米粉
一上桌就香到不行！米粉炒得很干爽，不会油腻，每一根都裹着虾油的香气。虾肉质弹牙🦐，咬下去是那种“Q弹爆汁”的感觉，锅气很足，越吃越香！
🍲 粿条虾汤
汤头清甜，是那种虾熬出来的自然鲜味。粿条滑溜溜的，入口很顺，配上鲜甜的虾，一口汤一口粿条，舒服到不想说话。
🥢 腐皮虾卷（超脆！）
必须夸爆这个！外皮炸到金黄酥脆，咬下去“咔嚓”一声非常解压😆 里面是扎实的虾肉馅，外酥里嫩，真的停不下来。
🥤 苹果酸梅水 & 酸柑酸梅水
解腻神器！酸酸甜甜超清爽，特别是吃完炸物来一口，直接清口✨ 酸柑那杯更清新一点，苹果那杯多一丝果香，都很好喝！
这么一桌居然不到40块！！性价比真的很能打💥
虾控真的会爱惨🦐🦐🦐
已经开始想下次再来吃了哈哈 😋
在新加坡能吃到这么地道的虾面，真的很可以了！下次还想挑战那只手臂虾🦐💪

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews:
Highly recommend to keep this as  your must try in your Singapore trip! Worth to try the shrimp noodles, tasting really nice!
Busy hours need to queue, but really worth the time!

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews: Riq was here. Splendid prawn mee, no wonder they got michellin star. Highly recommended. You have to queue during peak hour but move pretty fast. Will definitely come again

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews:
I visited this restaurant with one other person. When we arrived around 1:30 PM, there was already a line forming in front of the store. The waiting system requires customers to queue outside, and we were seated at approximately 2:45 PM, so the total waiting time was about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

After placing our order, the food was served within 10 minutes, which was quite prompt and efficient. In terms of service, while this restaurant has gained significant popularity, the overall service ex

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews:
A very light and flavourful fresh prawn soup base - its not like the extra thick and rich kind of prawn noodles soup that wows you at once but the refreshing clean umami taste grows on the palate over time. i love pouring more of their light chilli powder which elevates the flavours even more.

I would stick to the dry version of the prawn hokkien mee for a more flavourful experience.

bonus pt - price point is great too!

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews: Very long queue and wait for somewhat average quality food. The place is mostly tourists and with the lack of locals, one can only imagine.

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews: So disappointed. Tried the fried bee hoon version at their MBS outlet and was so amazed that I braved rain to try their main outlet at Killiney. Paid a hefty $42 for 2 bowls of fried bee hoon and 1 dry noodle and wait for food was long but these are all forgiveable if the taste was good. But alas I was so disappointed. Taste was not even half as good as MBS and I felt so bad for all the tourists who dont know any better. Please get your standards right if you are going to brag about being Michelin and charge $18 for prawn noodles!

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews:
Tried Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee, and it absolutely earns its name 🦐

The dry noodles come perfumed with that irresistible wok hei, each strand glossy and packed with flavor. The prawns are plump, fresh, and snap with every bite. The soup? Deep, rich, and comforting, yet surprisingly clean on the palate, like a warm hug that does not overstay its welcome.

Definitely worth it for the quality and portion.

Pro tip: Swing by outside peak hours unless you enjoy bonding with the queue.

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews: Just recommended this place by my Gen Z daughter who raved about the prawn noodles here. My husband and I finally tried it and were not as impressed. We enjoyed the refreshing green apple and sour plum drink, but the noodles were very average. I think most Gen X/ Y who grew up on real authentic prawn noodles would agree that there are much better ones out there 😅

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews: Food is amazing but service is a little slow for an eatery like this.

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews:
50분이나 기다려서 겨우 음식을 받았음. 그런데 내가 주문한 메뉴가 아닌 다른 메뉴가 나왔고, 당황하고 있는 사이 점원이 오더니 사과 한마디 없이 "이거 네 거 아니다"라며 휙 가져갔음. 그러더니 곧바로 이미 다른 손님이 휘저어 놓은 제 메뉴를 가져다줌. 남이 이미 손을 댄 음식을 아무렇지도 않게 내놓는 위생 관념에 충격받았음. 점원을 불러도 계속 무시당했고, 서비스와 위생 모두 최악이었음. 정말 기분 더럽고 불쾌한 경험이었음.그리고 정말 그냥 새우탕면을 비싸게 먹는느낌. 제발 기다리지말고 바쿠테나 한그릇 더 드시길...
🇺🇸
I waited for 50 minutes just to get my food. First, they brought me the wrong dish, and while I was confused, a server suddenly came over, snapped "This isn't yours," and snatched it away without a single apology. Then, they brought back my actual order—which had clearly already been stirred and touched by another customer. I was appalled that they would serve food someone else had already messed with. To make matters worse, the staff kept ignoring me when I tried to call them over. Worst service and hygiene ever. It was a disgusting and infuriating experience.
🇯🇵
50分も待ってようやく料理が出てきました。ところが、注文したものとは違うメニューが届き、困惑していると店員が来て、謝罪の一言もなく「これ、あんたのじゃない」と言ってひったくるように持っていきました。その後すぐに運ばれてきたのは、すでに他の客が箸をつけて混ぜてしまった私の料理でした。他人が手をつけたものを平気で出す衛生観念に驚愕しました。店員を呼んでも無視され続け、サービスも衛生面も最悪です。本当に不快で汚らわしい体験でした。

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews:
Very very crowded prawn mee restaurant, we queued for 15mins before getting a table.
Convenient service as we could order and pay online, with the staff serving us the food.

I’m a sucker for dry noodle, hence I liked the taste of prawn mee here. Soup also very tasty! Prawns were big and juicy, easy to remove shell as the middle part of the prawns had shell removed. Overall will be back here!

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews:
Food is ok, but super expensive! It is a ripped off especially if you go for the big or big big prawn ! Worst if u add on the prawn. Never select big prawn or big big prawn, $8 for a 3 inches prawn ! The service lady was patient and kind to serve and when I questioned her on where is my added big prawn, she pointed at the 3 inches prawn, and said “ it is like that one “. Now that makes 2 shops in kiliney i will never go, it is a ripped off, cheating if u ask me.

4/2/2026
I was impressed by your sincere reply, unfortunately the ripping off never change. You are still serving 3 in prawn for big prawn price. I think in your understanding, big means 3in.

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews: One of the best prawn noodle spots I’ve tried! The soup is very flavourful and not overly salty, with a strong prawn aroma. Portions are generous, especially the prawns. Noodles soaked up the broth really well. Overall, very satisfying and worth the visit. Highly recommended👍🏻👍🏻

Restaurant Name: Da Shi Jia Big Prawn Mee
Reviews:
This is the place to go for prawn noodles. What really sets it apart is how customisable everything is—you can choose the size of the prawns, the type of noodles, and all the add-ons to build your perfect bowl. The prawns were impressively large, incredibly fresh, and cooked just right—juicy, sweet, and succulent with a satisfying bite. Each mouthful felt indulgent and well worth it.
Don’t skip the beancurd skin prawn roll either. It was fried to absolute perfection: beautifully crisp on the outside, packed with flavour on the inside, and not oily at all, which made it dangerously easy to finish in one sitting.
To round off the meal, the fresh lime juice with sour plum was the perfect refresher. Bright, tangy, and just the right balance of sour and sweet, it cut through the richness of the food and left the palate feeling refreshed.
Overall, a highly satisfying meal with quality ingredients, generous portions, and thoughtful execution. Definitely a spot I’d return to when craving a really good bowl of prawn noodles.
独特なスパイシーカレー、とても香りが豊か。辛さのキレが違う。スッと喉もとを抜けていく、シャープな切れ味。あっさり味に感じるくらい洗練されている。何よりも驚くのはナン🫓の香り、ほんのり甘さ、重量感など。胃袋にドンとくる。
Food you find yourself craving again after you've left (exponentially more chaotic during Sundays & dinnertimes . . but in many ways that's part of the experience)

Took butter chicken naan set . Cost - 6 sgd

The naan was great but the butter chicken was not well made. Felt like i was having chicken in tomato soup.

Really dissapointed ... might try some other curries next time as the naan was really good , but never the butter chicken !!!

I usually go to Shan E Punjab but for some reason they were shut today.  So having seen rave reviews about Delhi Lahori I thought nows a great time to try them out

I was dreadfully disappointed. The food was nothing special at all. The rice was a tad sticky. The variety of dishes was poor too. My garlic naan was doughy in the middle

All in all a disappointment and I shall not be returning again

Tender chicken which is amazing. Naan is pretty thick and doughy. Don't know how the price is computed for "upgrading" the naan set. Lamb kebab ($7), tandoori chicken ($5), butter chicken naan set (upgraded to garlic and butter naan) ($11). Changing the naan increased the price from $6 to $11. It also takes longer, so you can consider sticking to the basic naan (long shape).
For sure the best food we had in Singapore. And the cheapest. I think I could eat this every day for the rest of my life. I’ll dream about this naan forever

Had the butter chicken and garlic naan here after seeing the great reviews. However was a bit disappointed, butter chicken tasted very different to all of the other butter chickens I've had before, tasted very peppery which wasn't nice.

Had to come try since it's a Michelin recommended spot. Their naans are really good. Soft and fluffy. The butter chicken was different compared to other shops but I wouldn't say its better. To each their own I guess. But overall the food is good, why they're Michelin bib, I'm not entirely sure
Will be dreaming about this garlic naan for a long time! Great food, quick service, kind staff. Recommend!

Fabulous hot and fluffy naan that I still think about from my visit 10 days ago. I feel another meal there is necessary. While the portions are good and I was full, I think I could eat more because it was delicious!

The ordering process is easy. Line up, order and wait. But also look around to see what else people have ordered so I could order more.

You can even pay by credit card!

The only downside is that food is served on styrofoam plates. It did take away from my enjoyment a smidgen.

Would definitely return to eat there. Maybe today!
Decent price/taste for a hawker stall.. BUT price fluctuates depending on weekday/end.
best food i had in singapore, and the best indian food i’ve ever had! garlic butter naan was so amazing!

Such a disappointment. The quality of food is pathetic!! There are quite a few better options around in the same food centre.

The seekh kebab was fried beforehand and then burnt in the tandoor before being served. The dal makhni smelled and tasted weird. Probably had gone bad already. We eventually ate some of the burnt naan and burnt chapati with the only decent thing served - the sliced onions with chutney (which was the free accompaniment btw)
Absolutely disgusting. I could not finish the meat as it tasted aweful. The butterchicken has zero flavour. Def not Michelin standard
Can't express what a saviour this has been during my one month stay!
Loved their paneer butter masala and the cheese garlic naan bread! Truly friendly people and just a great place to eat.
Seekh kebabs are the standout here that you need to visit for. Naans are on point as well.

Ordered the butter chicken set. The naan is very good. Crispy skin with chewy doughy interior. But the butter chicken is average (although the chicken is tender, the gravy is not that flavourful). It comes with two naans, which is a bit much compared to the small portion of butter chicken. Would order the dishes separately next time
Best Indian I’ve ever had! The chicken in the butter chicken was so flavourful and tender and the garlic naan was great. Really great price for Singapore too! Highly recommend

I got soo hungry so I went to this nice mensa place to get some yummy butter chicken. So the boss of this georgeous place gave me butter chicken for free. Big shoutouts to this friendly fellow. It is so tender and delicious.
The best best food I have ever tried here in Singaore. Must recommended 👌
It was alright… did not live up to my expectations as a Pakistani myself

The food was pretty decent although the hype did not live up to expectation

The butter chicken lack punch although i did ordered sweet butter chicken so maybe spicy butter chicken will have more punch

Naan was good although doesn't deserve the Michelle guide it feels like they anyhow put and every influencer reviewing this is getting paid from my pov

The service was good though and was pretty filling
Cheese naan was absolutely delicious.

Saw gd review abt their Nann n butter chicken, decided to order the mutton n garlic naan instead $7 for tt set. Taste was alright, mutton was tender. Garlic was fragrant but alittle too doughy, mutton gravy lack punch. 6/10 for that.

We ordered naan and gravy. The naan was best and is 5/5 but the gravy was watery and not tasty at all. So if some wants to try from this restaurant, try their garlic naan. Keep in mind one garlic naan is enough for 2 people as they provide big two pieces.

The food here at Dehli Lahori was absolutely fantastic, the cheese and garlic naan was made and cooked fresh right in front of my wife and i, we had the butter chicken also, the flavour was out of this world, by far the best Indian food we have ever had and we are from Australia where there is plenty of options.  Portion size was good and the people working there are very friendly and polite. I 100% reccomend you try this place, you will not be dissapointed.

Anna made us feel instantly comfortable and genuinely welcome. She strikes a rare balance: attentive without being intrusive, warm without overdoing it. With Daniel, they create the perfect atmosphere: casual fine dining, high standards but never stiff or intimidating.

Then the food arrives… and that’s really where Dill shines.
The level of detail in every plate is remarkable. Even before tasting anything you notice the care: beautiful bowls and plating, thoughtful presentation, and yes — even the bread board feels considered rather than an afterthought.

Flavours: exceptional. The produce tasted incredibly fresh, almost shockingly so. The langoustine and the cod were genuinely memorable dishes. The sauces and jus were precise, balanced and deeply flavourful — the kind you slow down for because you don’t want the bite to end.

The wine pairing was super cleverly curated.

This is one of those rare restaurants you want to tell everyone about… while secretly hoping it stays your own little discovery. A real gem.
Excellent address. Welcoming and attentive service. High quality ingredients. Delicious Scandinavian food. We thoroughly enjoyed it.
Incredible meal! Anna and Daniel are wonderful hosts.

Food on the set menu was very well executed. In my opinion, the textures and flavours were very good, and the sauces were in particular excellent.
Came for a birthday celebration and asked in advance for a candle on the dessert, but was very pleasantly surprised by a complimentary candle on their cookie instead.
Looking forward to coming back for their next rotation in set menu!

Dill is, without question, one of the best dining experiences we’ve had anywhere in the world! As New Yorkers lucky enough to have eaten at many of top restaurants globally, we don’t say that lightly - yet this Norwegian gem in the heart of Singapore is firmly in our top tier.

Co-owners Anna and Chef Daniel are not just great hosts, but fantastic people. Anna’s warmth and genuine hospitality make you feel instantly at home, and Daniel’s passion and precision shines through every dish.

The food is exceptional. The cod and onglet were beautifully executed, the potatoes somehow unforgettable, and the langoustine was genuinely one of the best bites we’ve ever had. The wine pairing was exquisite, hand-selected by Anna and perfectly matched to each course.

We only visited Singapore for a few days, yet after our fantastic dinner experience we returned again for lunch, which says it all! If we lived locally, we would be regulars. Anyone living in or visiting Singapore should put Dill at the top of their list!!

Celebrating our daughter’s 21st birthday at this Scandinavian restaurant on Duxton Hill. The husband-and-wife owners, Anna and Daniel are genuinely kind and welcoming. Each of the dish done is thoughtfully prepared using high-quality and organic ingredients. The ingredients are top-notch and we can really taste the quality. A truly hidden gem👍🫶

Wow! I had high expectations given the good reviews but I was absolutely blown away. I did the 5 course tasting menu with paired wines and everything was excellent. The food and the wines were all thoughtfully curated with exceptionally fresh ingredients. Plus the service was so down to earth and friendly, they really took care of me even though I was a solo diner. A must whilst you're in Singapore

Tried the waffle with löyrom, toast skagen with fermented turnips, and cod with potato purée at Dill. Every dish was beautifully executed and full of thoughtful flavours. I loved the waffle so much (I still think about it!). It was served warm and absolutely delicious. The potato purée was incredibly fluffy and comforting.

The service was amazing, and the owners and waitress were incredibly warm and welcoming. They explained every dish and checked in on us throughout the meal.

The lady owner also kindly offered us a small complimentary snack, which was such a thoughtful touch. She was incredibly sweet and very cheerful.

A really lovely dining experience overall. Highly recommend.

A really lovely meal we both thoroughly enjoyed.

Every one of the six courses was simple in the best sense of the word - allowing the flavour of the (excellent) main ingredients to shine.

Execution was spot on, and balance eminently judicious - the long pepper in the duck jus, and the juniper in the trifle were standouts.

Some dishes could probably afford to be a little larger for what you’re paying, but no regrets whatsoever for the quality of food and warmth of service.

First time dining in after hearing a lot of good things and taking a 1st dive in Scandinavian food. The ambiance is cosy and curated. On the floor, they take care of you with a friendly warm touch. The chef comes out almost for every dish to explain the cuisine. I would suggest the wine pairings with the set menu.
The wagyu and the langoustine really stood up.
Will def come back again ! :)

Came here for our anniversary dinner because we wanted to try Scandinavian food and we absolutely loved it 🥺 The service was amazing, and the staff really took the time to explain every dish on the menu. Our favourite was definitely the cod with potato purée. The cod literally melts in your mouth, and the creamy potato purée pairs with it perfectly. TRULY HEAVEN — I’ll be dreaming about it. I would 100% come back just for that fish!! 🐟

And the chocolate chip cookie… another killer. It looks like any regular cookie, but trust me it was soft on the inside and super crispy on the outside 🤤🍪

Portions are on the smaller side and yes, it is pretty expensive 🫣 BUT with the quality of food, the service and the cosy ambience, it’s definitely worth splurging on for a special occasion 😝 We ordered 2 sides, 2 mains, and 2 desserts, and the total came up to about $200 💸

/ waffle with löjrom / – $31
Löjrom is apparently the Scandinavian version of caviar 🤩 The waffle itself is one of the best I’ve had. Would totally order this à la carte if they offered it 😜

/ sourdough with Norwegian butter / – $10
Our least favourite dish of the night. Nothing bad — just nothing special 🍞

/ wagyu onglet, tarragon, kailan / – $49
The wagyu was cooked perfectly, super tender and flavourful 😙🤌🏻

/ cod, potato, leeks / – $49
The star ⭐️ of the night. An absolute MUST order 🤩

/ chocolate chip cookie / – $9
Still have no idea how a cookie can taste THIS good 🍪🤤

/ svele with brown cheese ice cream / – $19
A traditional Norwegian pancake — it pairs so well with the ice cream. Yummm 🤩

Hidden gem! Nestled on Duxton Road. Dill brings a slice of Nordic ingredients (seafood, brown cheese, aquevit, ramsløk! Sauce) to Singapore with a relaxed yet refined atmosphere - loved the wooden interiors and minimalist aesthetic create a warm, inviting space.

The set tasting menu weaves together fresh seafood, earthy vegetables, and fermented elements. Recommend!

My favorite restaurante in Singapore! The food was wonderful, surprising, and unpretentious. The chef is super creative and humble. I loved tasting Scandinavia in every dish. I recommend this restaurant and will be back next week.

We had such an amazing night here. The food felt like a hug from Europe. It’s high-quality ingredients, clean flavors, and no fuss at all, just really great food cooked perfectly. Everything was well thought through. The owners are super kind and welcoming people, which made the whole experience even better. This place feels really special, and we’ll definitely be back.

“Cod, potato purée, ramson, cucumber”

The cod is amazing! 🐟🤩🤯👌🏼🍽️
Excellent tenderness… can cut it with a spoon! 🥄

The “Smörgåsbord” is unique and interesting.

Nice 👌🏼 Ambience! Cosy environment.

First time having Scandinavian cuisine.
It was a surprisingly pleasant experience for me! Worth it.

I had no prior experience with Scandinavian cuisine, but my visit to Dill was thoroughly enjoyable. The staff was attentive and genuinely cared about our experience. We opted for the set dinner with wine pairing, which was excellent. The flavors were delicate and well-balanced, and the presentation was simple yet elegant. Overall, Dill offers a down-to-earth dining experience without unnecessary frills. Their frequently refreshed menu makes me eager to return and explore more!

Third time here and will be coming back for more!

The service is impeccable with a very friendly host from the husband and wife owner and their staff. More than willing to Share about the food especially as I am unfamiliar with Scandinavian food.
Their ingredients are fresh from Norway and the region and you can really taste the difference from the quality.

I really enjoy the toast skagen as their prawn is unlike anything else I have eaten. It has an almost meaty texture and the flavour was just delightful. Have gotten it everytime I have been there and is a must have!

Also had their Xmas set menu where the cos fish was cooked to perfection with it being flakey soft and flavourful. The reindeer paired with the celeriac purée masked any gaminess in the meat and was tender.

Though it might be on the pricier end, but for the quality that you are getting in terms of the food. Coupled with the excellent service and ambience, I would say it’s worth the experience!

I tried the set menu at Dill in Singapore, and it was outstanding. Every dish was delicious and well-crafted, the wine pairings were excellent, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. Great food, great service, and a truly enjoyable dining experience. Highly recommended!

Went there for lunch and tried the flæskesteg sandwich, absolutely incredible. The staff were extremely welcoming and helpful, and it was refreshing to enjoy some Scandinavian food for a change. I can highly recommend Dill and the flæskesteg sandwich!

Nothing short of Dill-icious!
So lovely to find this husband-wife team where the food is all cured and prepared in-house.

Love the clean Scandinavian flavours. Highly recommend the Smörgåsbord if you cannot decide on which open-face sandwich to have! The sandwich with Norwegian curried chicken and green apple slices was something new and refreshing for me.

Thank you to Daniel and Anna who showed such great hospitality. The free cinnamon bun (Kanelbolle) at the end was also a nice surprise.

Ambience was great and conducive for quiet conversations. Loved the clean washrooms, fresh flowers/eucalyptus, hand towels.. everything felt comfortable.

Would love to visit again to try the seasonal menus!

First time trying Scandinavian food and it exceeded our expectations. Had the set menu with wine pairing and it was a a great choice. Everything was good and the taste was delicate. Had the best mussels which were actually crunchy instead of chewy in most cases. The service was attentive and made everyone felt at ease and comfy, even as the restaurant was full house on a Saturday night. Will love to go back and try the food again.
Back for the second time yesterday! And it was still excellent. Really liked the waffle starter and the cod main. That mash potato was so creamy. Would be back!

These guys are absolutely amazing…deceptively simple dishes made and served with a quiet confidence in skill.

Anna and Daniel are running a beautiful, small operation that belies its simplicity. Considering the refinement of their dishes (both lunch and dinner), the reception and service you get is that of a warm, homely country kitchen that got supplanted into the quiet Duxton neighbourhood in this mad metropolis that is Singapore

Pork sandwich - 🤤 🤤
Fish soup - 🤤 🤤

I rarely write reviews but we had a fantastic time at Dill and it absolutely deserves top mark.

If you are not used to Scandinavian food, this is a great way to experience the traditional flavours. If you are familiar already, there are also enough surprises and twists for anyone to have a memorable time.

The whole experience felt very personal which elevates it above many other restaurants with a similar price range and style in Singapore. It is a great choice for a business lunch, a date or just having a good time with friends.

We had the set menu and they were able to cater to dietary restrictions. Some of the highlights included the cod, the langoustine and the juniper(!) ice cream. The staff was super friendly and took the time to check in on us and chat. It was great to find out more about how they prepare the food and run the place.

Celebrated a friend’s birthday here and we ordered the tasting menu :) swapped out the lamb for wagyu, every dish was bomb! Staff was super warm and friendly, prepared a birthday cake as well :) loved the decor and whole experience. Thank you for taking such great care of us! ❤️ will be back!

I don't have much experience with Scandinavian cuisine, so I'm trying to be mindful with my review of Dill. Overall, it was a lovely experience that left us feeling satisfied and refreshed.

The main dishes were standouts for me - the Toast Skagen with fermented turnips was a wonderful combination of flavors, and the cod, airflown from Norway, was perfectly cooked. I especially loved the creamy potato puree that came with the fish. And whatever you do, don’t miss out on the desserts!

A couple of the starters were just okay for me. The waffle with löyrom and the sourdough with Norwegian butter were nice, but they didn't really standout.

What I appreciated most was how clean all the dishes felt. It was a wonderful introduction to a cuisine I'm not familiar with.

Special shoutout to Anna for being such a fantastic host, treating us to a celebratory dessert and sharing great travel tips! ✨

As a Norwegian I wasn’t expecting to eat some of the most delicious Scandinavian dishes of my life in Singapore. Chef Daniel has constructed a set menu which I would highly recommend. The excellent wine pairing enhanced every dish. The price is very good for the quality you get, and cheaper than what you would have to pay for the same quality in Scandinavia. I also want to say a special thank you to Anna who is one of the warmest and most competent hostesses we have met. If you are looking for a true culinary experience then come here.

Really enjoyed the hospitality and personable food introduction by Anna! We had a great night with delicious norwegian food + cosy dining environment. The cod fish and langoustine were the highlights of our meal! Will definitely be back again 🫶🏻
Service is fast even though it is a 1 man show. I like the big dudu kueh, more satisfying.
Tutu had already been pre-prepared when we bought. Bought the ones with peanut fillings, abit too sweet for me. Texture abit hard, guess it had been left for a while. Price wise pretty affordable.
All the way go there but was closed! So sad and disappointed! Today - 21 dec 2025

Items were freshly prepared when we were there and while most reviews said the food was soft, ours were quite chewy and tough. We have had much better and softer du du kways else where and were quite disappointed as this place was so well reviewed. Would not come back again. Those those interested, can try the Haig Road Putu Piring. Those are much better.
Chewy, fluffy and tasty tutu kueh at affordable prices!

A few years before Du Du Shou Shi received their Bib Gourmand, I decided to try their tutu kueh and felt there was something special about their fragrant, steamed rice flour cakes with peanut or coconut filling.
Each of them is carefully prepared and shaped by hand using a metal mould and served atop a piece of Pandan leaf, giving it its classic shape and aroma.

The kuehs come in two sizes - regular smaller ones are S$3 for 5 pieces, and larger ones cost S$1.20 each. It is rare to see a stall purely dedicated to selling this delightfully light and fluffy local snack, and I’m glad they are recognised for their craft.
Grateful for small comforts like these — piping hot, delicately soft and moist with ample sweet, fragrant coconut and peanut fillings. Just what we needed.
Been awhile since I last ate tutu kueh and these r so good!!! I ate 5 and ordered 5 more, love the plain ones!!!!!
First time buying Kueh Tutu. This one tastes great, texture is different from Haig Road putu piring, not as sweet too.
Unbelievable flavor! I ate them all and will likely return tomorrow for more.
So good till bought 10 small Coconut and travelled all the way from Orchard after work🤭
Hardworking young man working hard preparing all the tutus by hand. Taste wise ok but found the texture to be on the hard/ dry side, different from what I’m used to. Not bad after all
Due to the renovation of 505 Jurong market, came to 22a Havelock food center to get my TU TU fix at uncle's 2nd stall. Definitely worth it 😊

Choice of kueh tutu with coconut or peanut fillings.
Small coconut kueh tutu ($3 for 5 pieces) - Good. Pre-made but kept warm.
Big coconut kueh tutu ($1.20 for 1 piece) - Made à la minute with a higher ratio of filling to flour compared to the small kueh tutu but the filling was a little too sweet.
麵皮不厚，料蠻飽滿，不錯吃。可惜，招牌沒寫有什麼口味，沒點到花生

B.E.S.T tutu kueh ever. Been having their tutu kueh since I was a kid. I am so happy that they have earned their Michelin star. ⭐️

The fragrant, softness of the flour is phenomenal. I only wish they sell plain tutu kueh with no fillings in it I can easily eat 10.

My personal favourite is coconut filling. So well done! Peanut is equally good too. Do yourself a favour, please eat it while it hot. ☺️

Flour and filling recipe created by an old uncle. If you see the old uncle selling he is the OG. Now taken over by his son. I am so grateful for him to help continue the legacy so I can continue to enjoy this beautiful snack. And he kept the taste of it same like how his dad does it! Thank you 🙏

It’s quite hard to find authentic, soft tutu kuehs these days and they sell them here. The tutu is thinner not too thick therefore it was soft. The interior complemented the exterior well. I particularly liked the peanuts. I’ve always preferred peanuts. It’s a personal preference. But the tutus here are quite smaller in circumference and height so $3 for 5 makes them really expensive. But materials like flour are on the rise, so it’s probably justified. I probably only eat once in a while.
Hidden gem. So good!!!

I can't stop eating.😍
It's made with rice flour. It's simple and knowledgeable, but it's a taste that you can't stop eating once you eat it. Thank you for for kind today. I will be there again soon!😊
“Nyun Kit Kit” (IYKYK) 👍

First time trying mini tutu kuehs and I must say they are quite interesting, in a good way. They are a little harder than the big ones but the peanut and coconut fillings are quite delicious. Freshly steamed, it’s always best to eat on the spot. Will be trying out the normal bigger versions next time.
My favourite stall for Tu tu kuey since I was student. Uncle's son now run the stall in the day time. Lovely to see uncle in the evenings and always passionate to serve.

Came on a Wed morning around 9am. No visible queue and the tutu kuehs were alr made but kept warm in the cart.

I tried it while it was hot but it was a tad disappointing. The kueh was towards the dry side. Both peanut and coconut filling were alright. Personally had better tutu kueh so this is something I would give a miss.
Simple food but done well - favourite has to be the traditional coconut one! Love it when it’s piping hot!

I’ve not been able to find this traditional shaped Dudu since my childhood! To me it’s always nicer than the modern flower shaped version.

Frequent this place a lot and glad it’s near my house. Clean and always polite. Hope you guys carry on this traditional dessert forever!
The best Dudu kuih in Singapore

Featuring my favourite childhood snack - 𝐓𝐮𝐭𝐮 𝐊𝐮𝐞𝐡 from Du Du Cooked Food 嘟嘟熟食! They used to cost $2 for 4 back when I was living near the market, but these bite-sized treats are now still affordable at $3 for 5 pieces (blame shrinkflation for the price hike)!

The steamed kueh is soft and pillowy, comes with a generous serving of filling and more importantly, retains its texture even when cooled (but best eaten warm for the best flavour experience)! They come in two flavours: the more traditional neon-orange coconut filling or the ground peanut/brown sugar mix, though I prefer the former for its lightly toasted coconut flavour.

If you are up for something fancy, they also have an XL version which costs $1.20 a pop! While it's wider and flatter (about the size of two regular tutu kuehs), the texture was a bit drier & the fillings didn't scale according to size. Would recommend sticking to the regular ones instead.
.

crab not fresh. taste not good. not worth the money.

The food is decent but the price is exorbitant. Can get the same quality at half the price.

Was there just now to pack food.. was rejected by the counter staff and say no take away.. I drive all the way there and they rejected my order. This is crazy. Should have put no take away to avoid confusion. Sad to be there.
Popular due to being on China social media. Should upgrade the furniture
Quán cháo ếch nổi tiếng rất đông thực khách ở khu Geylang, khá ngon nhưng giá khá cao

Worst restaurant experience ever. They seriously rip people off here. I ordered a small portion but they gave me a medium and then lied, saying the small and medium are the same size anyway. On top of that, they had the nerve to tell us to pay while we were still eating. The food was awful. the swikee and all the meat tasted old and definitely not fresh. They clearly take advantage of visitors, because the prices charged didn’t match the ones on the menu. Totally dishonest place. Would NOT recommend to anyone.
食物全部是味精，你们去试 看会口渴吗 然后地方又肮脏又热 一点食欲都没有！

When we arrived, while waiting in line to order, the waiter kept saying there wasn't enough food and suggested we order this and that, which resulted in a lot of waste. When it came time to pay, they asked for cash or WeChat Pay, saying they didn't have a credit card payment machine. How could a famous restaurant insist on cash payments?

I felt like this shop was taking advantage of tourists, insisting on cash payment.
田雞的肉質蠻有彈性，還不錯吃。鐵板鹿肉和花枝圈都是菜單裡推薦的菜，可是對我來説偏鹹，拉低了整個用餐體驗。如果想試試，最好4點到，因爲我們吃飽要離開的時候，坐位幾乎全滿。
The food tastes are not good but the price is very high! The value isn’t there.

2 frogs for $18, but charged us $28. $10 was for veg and porridge. Paid $42 then realized it's too much.

牛車水大廈(Chinatown Complex)的hawker center的一個攤檔，為米其林推薦，販售港式燒臘麵點等，攤名中的「過橋麵檔」個人認為應只為表示其料理過程中食料的移位而已，這次看了攤名中的「肥牛」所直接點的牛腩麵說實在感受不太到什麼其他中式料理中的過橋特色，感覺就是個典型的港式牛腩撈麵，而這麵的麵條本身普通，牛腩滋味足且不膩口，吃完一段時間之後也沒有膩感，整體而言還不錯，唯再次感到印象深刻、而且是偏負面的印象依然是不少新加坡hawker center所有的太過陽春幾乎到了克難程度的用餐環境尤其是餐具碗盤。這次在Chinatown Complex的這個攤檔所品嚐的牛腩麵的盛盤竟然是保麗龍材質，然後湯匙和湯碗全塑膠，實在有些驚訝，新加坡的hawker center大多要求食客用完餐後須自行清理桌面，連桌子都要擦乾淨，然後餐碗盤自行拿去回收等(不做上述這些可能會面臨罰款)，而像這樣的保麗龍盤子連回收都不用，直接拿到垃圾筒丟棄即可，可以理解這一切是來自food center在管理環境時的效率、便利、與成本的考量，不過新加坡作為一個先進國家，個人不禁好奇小販中心在成本考量與環境尤其是餐具品質(which is related to eaters' health)之間的平衡點是否還有可能在光譜上作些許調整？

Ps. Fatty Ox早上7.30-8.00開始營業，單就餐點本身適合做為早餐的選擇之一

Paid $6 for a bowl of beef brisket noodle.
The beef brisket noodles at this humble stall, honestly, it’s really no big deal. If you’ve had the real deal from Hong Kong, you’ll immediately notice the difference—this falls far short. The broth lacks depth, the brisket is decent but nothing remarkable, and the noodles don’t have that signature springy bite. At best, it’s mediocre. That said, the stall is run by two elderly women who have clearly been at it for years. Their dedication is admirable, and you can’t help but appreciate their tenacity. While the food itself isn’t anything special, I’d still support their effort to keep this legacy going. If you’re in the area and want a simple, no-frills bowl of beef brisket noodles, it’s worth a visit—just temper your expectations.
Fatty Ox in the green zone of Chinatown Complex serves hard-to-find beef brisket noodles. The noodles are springy, and the gravy is really tasty. Rating: 😘😘😘😘😘

Michelin recommended with bowls starting at $5. though those seeking a Soy Sauce Chicken or whole Roast Duck can order without starch, suffice it to say that simple appearing plates pack a lot of punch thanks to springy Noodles and well-stuffed Dumplings while the Brisket is appropriately fatty and good on its own but better with a bit of Chili Paste.

The sio bak isn't just crispy - biting it is a tectonic event. It has a distinct, airy crackle that tastes like pure, salted indulgence. One bite and you’ll understand why the queue is so long everyday. Then there’s the char siew that’s been charred to a sticky, smoky, caramelized perfection. And don't forget the duck too! Go for the three meat combo with noodles - it's the best thing that's happened to Jurong, other than the MRT.

Fei Fei Wanton Mee serves one of the most satisfying bowls around. The char siew is extremely tender, juicy and nicely caramelised — easily one of the best parts of the meal. Their duck is also very tasty, soft and flavourful without being too oily. The noodles are cooked perfectly with a good springy texture, and the wantons are fresh and well-seasoned.

However, be prepared for a long queue, especially during peak hours. The service can be quite slow, so waiting is expected. That said, the food quality usually makes the wait worthwhile. Even with the slower pace, the staff still try their best to handle the crowd.

Overall, if you don’t mind queueing, Fei Fei Wanton Mee is worth a visit for its tender char siew, tasty duck and perfectly cooked noodles. It’s a solid bowl that keeps people coming back despite the long wait.

I arrived at 8 am on a Saturday, ahead of their opening time, hoping to beat the queue. However, there were already 10 people waiting. Two people gave up along the way, and when the stall finally opened, I waited another 15 minutes before I could order, as most patrons placed multiple orders.

I opted for their signature wanton mee ($5) but decided to add on char siew for $2 when I collected my order, as the meat portion initially looked quite small compared to everyone else who had topped up. If you're considering adding extra meat, I highly recommend the char siew. It's exceptionally good, with a great mix of lean and fat, and it's cut thick. Besides, good char siew is rarer to find in Singapore than Sio Bak and roasted duck.

The egg noodles were springy and perfectly cooked, with absolutely no alkaline 'kee' aftertaste. The lard bits were big, chunky, and crispy. Both the chilli sauce and pickled green chillis complemented the dish well.

In comparison, the wanton soup was basic. While the wantons themselves had a good skin-to-meat ratio, the soup was rather bland.

Nonetheless, for the char siew alone, I'm willing to come back to queue. However, next time I will probably come by on a weekday instead as I overheard from other patrons that the queue will be shorter.

Wantan were flavourful morsels of pork and shrimp. Even the oft-forgotten soup was above-average. $5 was worth it, queue notwithstanding. The springy noodles are cooked to perfection, offering a satisfying chew, while the succulent char siew boasts a delicate sweetness from its caramelised glaze and melt-in-the-mouth tenderness. The wontons are generously filled.

If you’re in the area with time to spare, this spot is worth the wait—just brace yourself for potential queue-jumping antics and focus on the reward at the end: a hearty, well-executed bowl of comfort.

Fleur De Sel 的菜确实很有层次感，每一道都像是在法式传统中加入了细腻的现代感。
先上来的这碗汤，质地轻盈却香气浓郁，喝起来有浓厚的奶油香，底层藏着一点海鲜的甜味和淡淡的坚果气息，入口滑顺、尾韵柔和。那种法式的温润厚重被处理得刚刚好，不腻也不淡。

接着这道前菜色彩缤纷，上面堆满了各种新鲜的香草与嫩芽，底层是蟹肉沙拉，混合着一点牛油果慕斯与柠檬酸奶酱。第一口下去是凉爽的，酸度明亮、香草的气息在口中慢慢铺开。蟹肉鲜甜，质地细滑，每一口都带点花香和柑橘清香，很开胃。

松露意大利饺那道简直是经典。酱汁是用奶油和黑松露打成的，香气浓烈却不掩盖主角。饺皮薄而弹，里面的馅柔软带点咸香。整个盘子香气四溢，每一口都像是在咬出一阵松露云。那种「厚实又轻盈」的矛盾感，正是这家餐厅的功力。

最后这道最令人印象深刻的是那份“鱼子酱开场”的料理。底下是细腻的生虾塔塔，表面堆上满满的黑鱼子酱，最后桌边现淋上浓郁的南瓜海鲜泡沫。第一口是海的鲜、咸、甜在舌尖炸开的感觉；第二口开始能感受到南瓜的温润和微微的甜感把鲜味包起来。那一刻真的有「法式的浪漫」在嘴里绽放的感觉。

Fleur De Sel 的菜品不浮夸，但每一道都精准、层次丰富，香气、质感、温度都拿捏得很到位。吃完之后的感觉不是「被震撼」，而是「被温柔征服」。

FOC has been one of my favourite Spanish restaurants in Singapore. I’ve visited three times, 1st time at their old Hong Kong Street location, and twice at their new outlet.

Second and third visits were still enjoyable, though the menu has changed and it wasn’t quite as mind-blowing as the first time. That said, the food quality remains good. The small plates and tapas are still my fav. and I appreciate the creativity and presentation.

From my recent visit, highlights included the foie gras terrine with caviar in crispy phyllo (still an all-time favourite), the anchovies and the patatas braves. Some dishes were more subtle in flavour, but overall still enjoyable.

One thing I wouldn’t recommend is the dessert with alcohol. It’s very photogenic and great for Instagram (especially with the fire), but taste-wise it was too strong on the alcohol and not very enjoyable. In hindsight, I should’ve listened to the staff and ordered something else.

Overall, still a solid place for Spanish food, especially if you enjoy tapas. I’d still come back.

Fu Ming Cooked Food is a popular hawker stall in Singapore, famous for its delicious and authentic carrot cake. Unlike the Western dessert, Singaporean carrot cake is a savory dish made from radish (locally called "white carrot") and rice flour, stir-fried with eggs, garlic, and preserved radish. Fu Ming offers both the "black" (with sweet dark soy sauce) and "white" (plain) versions, each bursting with wok hei (breath of the wok) and rich flavors. The crispy edges and soft, flavorful interior make it a must-try for locals and tourists alike. Affordable and satisfying, Fu Ming's carrot cake is a standout dish in Singapore's vibrant hawker scene.

There are quite a number of fried carrot cake stalls in the Redhill Food Centre. To those living in Redhill, you will know Fu Ming Cooked Food, which is affectionately known as the ‘Mickey Mouse’ stall as featured on its vintage signboard.

Despite the stall’s low-key, unpretentious appearance, you will be surprised that it was awarded the Michelin Bib Gourmand recognition in 2019, and has held this honour ever since.

The carrot cake here is sold in $3, $4, and $5 portions, in both black and white varieties, though black is the option you should definitely go for. Their radish cake is steamed and made fresh daily, which gives it a very soft and chewy texture, making it an easy meal for the elderly. Despite it being a little oily, I love how the fried carrot cake is moist inside, yet crispy on the outside. Fu Ming Cooked Food is definitely a gem here in the Redhill Food Centre.

A Truly Perfect Experience

Ristorante Garibaldi in Singapore is an absolute benchmark for Italian fine dining. From the moment you walk in until the very last detail, everything is executed to perfection.

The quality of the ingredients is outstanding, with authentic, beautifully balanced dishes that fully express the soul of true Italian cuisine. Each course is presented with great care and served at exactly the right pace.

The service is exceptional: professional, attentive, and genuinely warm, making you feel welcomed and looked after without ever being intrusive. The wine list is simply endless, offering an extraordinary selection that can satisfy even the most knowledgeable wine lovers and perfectly complement every dish.

The atmosphere is elegant, refined, and inviting, ideal for a romantic dinner as well as for special or business occasions.

In short, a restaurant without a single flaw — everything was outstanding. A true reference point for Italian cuisine in Singapore. Highly recommended, and I will definitely return.

Had a truly lovely lunch at Garibaldi today. The ambience was perfect for a quiet, relaxing afternoon — elegant, calm, and ideal.
We opted for the 3-course lunch, and every dish was beautifully prepared and well-balanced. The flavours were refined yet comforting — exactly what you’d hope for from a quality Italian restaurant.
A special mention to K Sandhu, who was incredibly professional and attentive. He made the entire experience feel smooth and welcoming. He also has excellent wine knowledge — his recommendations were spot-on and complemented the meal perfectly. 👍🏼
Great food, peaceful setting, and outstanding service. A place I’d happily return to and recommend!

Lovely dinner at Garibaldi. Beautifully plated dishes with standout flavours. The prawns were fresh and juicy, and the fish was well‑seasoned. Desserts had just the right richness without feeling heavy. Service was friendly, warm and attentive. The space is quietly elegant and perfect for an unhurried conversation with friends or family.
A great stop for an authentic Italian meal. Garibaldi has been serving classic Italian cuisine in Singapore since 2003. They also have some tasty cocktails in their bar and a wide selection of wine.

Standard has dropped drastically since the last time I was here last year. Had the Cold Angel Hair pasta with snow crab and caviar (supplement of $25!). The portion was pitifully tiny and the crab was fishy and did not taste fresh. Chef's menu at $88.00 did not represent what we paid for. Even the tenderloin had a supplement of $48! Everything is overpriced and even the last course is coffee and tea OR dessert! What? Coffee or tea OR dessert? What is your coffee priced as much as dessert? I find their menu very mercenary and overly miserly. Compared to previous times we were here, the head waiter was friendlier and so proud of their coffee and even comped the coffee just to let the customers enjoy the coffee with dessert. Won't be back for a loooong time, if ever.
Fully deserving of the 4 stars. Very friendly and professional staffs coupled with fine Italian food.

The 5 course dinner was extremely good,  and my kids and wife truly enjoyed the dishes.The caviar, white truffle and foie gras paired dishes were outstanding. Top notch service with a well appointed atmosphere.

I had a wonderful experience at Garibaldi Italian Restaurant & Bar. The food was very tasty and fresh, with great overall quality. The service was pleasant, and the staff were extremely helpful, providing clear information and interacting politely and professionally throughout the meal.

The environment was surprisingly spacious, with additional seating on the side and a private room available, so it never felt crowded. Altogether, it was a very enjoyable visit. I highly recommend this place!
Good food, and awesome setting!
Food was fantastic, wine list incredible & the service equally so! The atmosphere of the small rooms is a bit quiet but I can imagine it’s better during a busier night!

Wonderful experience at Garibaldi! Went there for lunch to celebrate my wife’s birthday, and the team had prepared a lovely dining spot for the occasion.

Lovely lunch, great service and chef and wonderful food :) don’t let this place go to waste! It’s been 10 years!

Came here for lunch omakase on the Nov 12, 2024 (Tue).
The nodoguro was really outstanding!! Ordered another extra piece in the end. Other dishes were tasty too :) Definitely recommend and would revisit.

Ordered Botan set for lunch, food was good! It was my mum’s birthday on that day, the staff prepared an additional small cake with fruit platter for her and really made her day. Thank you for the nice food and good services!

We had the Nigiri Omakase for lunch. The standouts were definitely the Aburi Ootoro which added a layer smokiness and dimension to cut through the fattiness of the tuna.

Compared to the likes of Shinji and other popular omakases in town, the flavour of the different components like the yuzu zest, red vinegar and wasabi were not too overpowering, allowing the flavour of the fish to really shine through. We also enjoyed the quieter ambience of the place. A big bonus is that the staff don’t sing happy birthday which came as a big relief to my husband (haha!). That said, we loved that they celebrated the occasion with the candles, a hand written card with a printed photo of us, a mini tea gift which was surprisingly our favourite tea brand (maruyama nori) from Japan! We also liked that they switched to Hojicha during dessert, which helped to offset the very sweet but delicious kyoho grapes and melon that we had.

The only letdown was ironically the green tea they served during service. It tasted watered down and it lacked umami!
Thank you for the card. I love it

My friend took me to her local favourite for lunch and it was amazing.  It is a very classy but not fussy place with attentive, friendly and welcoming staff and the ambience is lovely.  I am a very difficult customer with some really fiddly allergies, but the staff were extremely knowledgeable and made me feel completely at ease, which I rarely feel with my allergy issues.  The food was exceptional - the trio of starters exquisite and the steak cooked perfectly.  Delicious bread and crisps and delicate but tasty desert.  Would so recommend, thank you very much to all for the highlight of my Singapore trip.

We had a fantastic dining experience at Gordon Grill located in the Goodwood Park Hotel! I ordered the USDA Black Angus Rib Eye steak that was cooked perfectly and very delicious. We would highly recommend Godon Grill and will definitely be back!

P.S. Sixteen bucks for water!!!! Please don't fall into that trap. Ask for tap or none at all.
Singapore’s oldest steakhouse; top quality service and food; absolutely delicious meal; thank you to manager Mages for taking care of us

Service was impeccable & food reliably good. As Goodwood Hotel drop off point is very close to the restaurant, access for my mother was very good. Mr Nair also arranged for carpark reimbursement for all my guests.

Thank you to the entire team for helping to facilitate our happy celebration.

Will definitely continue to host at Gordon's Grill.
Really enjoyed the food and really loved the service, shout out to Krishna for being such a kind and wonderful man!

We were looked after by Krishna and his team.

We will be back !
Our favourite place for quality steak, and highly recommended for special occasions. Impeccable service from Krishna and team!

We came for lunch without reservation together with our infant. Mr Krishna greeted and welcomed us and made us feel like home instantly. His service was 6 stars all the way. The food were the best we have had in Singapore during 2 weeks stay and the ambience subtle luxurious. Hope to visit again in the future and hopefully Mr Krishna greets us again. Next time I will also stay at the hotel.

Always a good experience at Gordon Grill where the food is good, meats are well done and service is excellent.

Excellent food, friendly staff.
Manager Krishna’s service is impeccable.

Thanks to Karshina and his team for such a friendly and enjoyable dining experience! 😊
Had a wonderful lunch to celebrate our anniversary. Krishna was attentive and did a super job!
Thank you, Krishna!  The food and ambience are all great.  Will be back for more.😄

Always happy to to dine at Gordon Grill!
Thank you Krishna for always looking after us.

My wife & myself had lunch on 27/12, Saturday. We were well served by the Manager Mr Mages Nair, Krishna, a lady staff & the team.
They were professional, attentive & made us feel warm & welcome.
The food was excellent but limited choices. It will be perfect if the chef can add more main course choices in the menu.
We enjoyed our lunch very much. Keep up the good work.
Great service by Magesh, introducing the wines and also food. Very enjoyable birthday lunch for me :)

Just celebrated our 34 th anniversary at our favourite restaurant and must say we are never disappointed!
Krishnan leads by example and creates a very welcoming dining atmosphere.
Highly recommended!
Impeccable service and superlative dishes.
Nice ambience and tasty food. Cozy spot to hang out and enjoy a good meal.

Just left this restaurant. Excellent food. Excellent service. Excellent ambience.

Located in Goodwood Park Hotel. This hotel has a Scottish design. So you can expect a touch of Scottish interior design in Gordon Grill.

This was my second visit.
Enjoyed the set lunch with wine.   The set lunch is very good value.  We will definitely return.
Fantastic service from Mage and team. Thanks all!
Had dinner with Wife. Delicious food and excellent service. Special commendation for Jacqueline who served us well.
An excellent experience, especially suitable for celebrating birthday! 😍🤩

Came here for weekday dinner because we couldn’t get a weekend booking which in the end was a blessing cos it wasn’t too busy, felt cosy and we had excellent service the whole way through
We ordered a varied range of food but I just absolutely LOVED my lamb chops done medium rare. I know people come here for the steak but prefer other meats and even my mum agreed the lamb was better than her  dish, the duo of beef fillet and beef cheek.

Grand merci au chef pour ce diner incroyable. On a ete ravis de l ambiance et des saveurs. Nous reviendrons encore ❤️❤️❤️

10/10 Must visit!

Great experience!

Fantastic service!
4 pax not worth $500, wagyu beef was the same as food court
loved the pasta, loved the calm atmosphere. Perfect spot for a quiet night out.
This restaurant is an excellent choice for takeaway meals.

Every dish was delicious. The prices are on the higher side, but the food quality is excellent. The service was outstanding — the staff gave great recommendations and were friendly and attentive throughout.

The staff generously treated us to complimentary desserts, including canale, chocolate and ice cream. Thank you very much

Visited with a friend for a quiet meal. The Cold Angel Hair Pasta lived up to its reputation — very refreshing and balanced. The Foie Gras was a bit rich for my taste, but well-cooked. Service was friendly but not intrusive.

The menu feels classic but with some interesting touches. Tried the Wagyu set and everything was nicely executed. Maybe a little pricey for lunch, but the quality matches. Staff were calm and professional.

Went for the seasonal lunch set. Everything was nicely timed and portions were balanced. The Wagyu was cooked to a perfect medium, and the pasta was refreshing as always. Dessert wasn’t overly complicated, but satisfying.

Came on a weekday for birthday celebration and was pleasantly surprised by the food quality. Easily one of the best meals I have had in Singapore (coming from a local). The food was so good that it beats some of the Michelin star restaurants I've tried.

Every dish was a hit, literally no misses.
We had the set lunch and everything was good but if we had to choose favorites, appetizer would be the seared atlantic squid (literal flavor bomb, never had squid seared this way before), dessert would be the apple tart. For mains, iberico pork jowl was so soft and flavorful. Lobster was perfectly cooked and paired well with the bearnaise sauce.  Even the complementary petite fours were so good! 🥹 (Photos provided may not serve the justice it deserves 😂)

Service was amazing as well and they even prepared a small birthday treat for us! Very sweet of the restaurant! Chef Gunther was walking around (with his local good morning towel) and asking for feedback, which made the whole experience much more genuine. We will definitely be back for another special occasion!

Dropped by on a weekend. Tried the Foie Gras and the tart — both well done. Nothing flashy, just clean flavors and nice presentation. It’s a smaller, more intimate setting, which makes it a bit different from the usual big dining spots.

I found it unusual that we were not allowed to order another bottle of wine at 14:30.  if I were the owner, I wouldn’t expect customers to be denied service, particularly after spending a significant amount on lunch. We also had to pour our own wine, and despite the restaurant appearing well staffed, attentive service was difficult to obtain.

The Cold Angel Hair Pasta really does live up to its reputation. Light but flavorful. Service was polite and unobtrusive, which fit the overall quiet atmosphere. Would consider coming back for a casual but refined dinner.

Gunther's, while not the flashiest of French restaurants, is still low-key amazing. My last visit there was for lunch nearly 10 years ago, but memorable enough that I had to return.

This humble fine dining option does not disappoint. Chef Gunther's signature cold truffle angel hair pasta was an absolute delight, although I recommend visiting during truffle season to elevate the dish a level higher, although it's delicious as is. Their lunch promo is a steal for this level of dining, although we went for dinner and opted for the 4 course degustation menu, and paired it with a fantastic bottle of white which was reasonably priced.

A 4 course dinner at a restaurant like this can sometimes leave you feeling hungry afterwards, yet we left content, even a bit full. Our server, Kat, as well as the other servers, were incredibly attentive, friendly, and prompt. Each dish was cooked to perfection and plated elegantly, never over the top, always humble. For dessert my partner opted for the apple tart, while I chose the farm cheeses - both simply fantastic. Then Kat brought us the truffle chocolates, financiers, and crispy-edged buttery canele that were a delightful compliment from the kitchen.

Our evening at Gunther's was a memorable one, we'll be back. Merci beaucoup for the experience!

Food was good but service was horrible. Waiters were very arrogant and snobbish especially the lady with black hair and black glasses. Chef was super friendly and he came out to check on us and made a couple of jokes to lighten the mood.

Excellent staff. Very attentive and professional.  Lunch is good value for the quality of food that was presented.  If you're on a budget, skip the foie gras but pay for uni on your pasta.  Apple tart was tasty.  Can get noisy as there is a lack of soft furnishings so good for fun groups.
Many classics executed to perfection. Had the pleasure of pairing this meal with an 09 HB. Beautiful meal from start to finish. Good place for a business meeting or a romantic evening.

Not a huge fan of caviar usually, but the Cold Angel Hair Pasta really changed my mind. Clean flavors, and the chillness of the dish just hit right. Rest of the meal was good too, especially the tart at the end.

Lunch was good! Small portions, but I guess that’s part of the experience. Cold Angel Hair Pasta stood out. I didn’t think I’d like it chilled but it totally worked. Might swing by again for a treat-yourself day.

It was a lovely evening as we celebrate my gf’s belated birthday. Every dish was creatively cooked and it brings out the full flavour of every ingredient. It is another level of culinary skills. kudos to Chef and his team and I will definitely be back again. Iberico ham platter just burst out with different level of flavour (just like an old world wine) Pork jowl was tender and literally melt in my mouth. Angel hair pasta was so flavorful that I can’t get enough of it. Dessert was so wonderful and we get to taste Chef’s home town crepe which remind him so much of home. 😉

Bad experience. Had dinner tonight. Glass broke while my daughter was drinking water and cut her lip. Table was wet from water spillage. Staff told us restaurant was full and could not change table. She put a napkin on the wet table and told us my daughter could sit where it was dry. We had to ask her if she could dry the table and redo the setting. She said yes and asked us to sit at the entrance to wait. Did not offer us water while waiting. At the end of the meal, chef came out and asked us ‘what we expected them to do’. He should have offered us something to make us feel better. He didn’t even offer an apology. Just told us he would take our feedback after my wife described the incident. At the end, I paid $480 for the bad experience and nothing else. I expected more from a fine dining restaurant that should focus on dining experience. I guess they didn’t care because they were fully booked anyway. Won’t go back anymore.

Disappointing.
Decor was non existent.
Mushroom tempura didn’t even have salt leave alone any flavour.
The main courses were passable.
French cuisine prides itself on patisserie. The canele’was dense with no filling ( custard or other) in the centre.
Below par considering the exorbitant prices.

Have been here a number of times. Usually the food is quite good and that’s why I brought my friends there today. Unfortunately service was terrible today and the waitress looked impatient and can’t wait to get us out. At 2.29pm, she curtly came over to tell us “we are closed”. Ok we get the message…I just cancelled my next reservation there. Won’t be coming back for awhile.

Had a birthday celebratiion at Gunther's this afternoon. Food was good but service was simply appalling! Unfortunately, I failed to get the waitress's name. She doesn't look local, filippino I think? Hair tied with black glasses. Wears no smile & appears aloof. At about 2.30pm, she came over to our table and said, "We are closed!" I had to go to the ladies before leaving and when I wasn't sure where it's located, she simply pointed to the direction of the toilet with an attitude! Wow... so much for our fine dinning experience! Such a shame really!

You know the place is good when even their plain bread is irresistible. Went for their set lunch and it was wonderful. Food presentation was stylish. Never seen a beef tartare served this way ( see picture). If even a regular 3 course set is this good, I can imagine their degustation menu to be excellent. Service was impeccable. Restaurant ambience was cozy and chic. A great dining experience.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: I ordered soup and dry version. Both are delicious! Suits my taste!

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: My last visit here was a few years back, and I'm surprised to see no more Q. Got the $7 mixed ingredients in dry version. It still tastes good, but the soup is too sweet. Disappointed. A middle-aged couple is helping the elderly couples

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: Now the standard drop

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: I seldom give 5 star but I must say this beef noodle exceed my expectations and I would say it's the best beef noodle I have tasted so far. I ordered 7 dollar beef noodle (sliced beef, beef ball, beef tendon, stomach) every part is tender and smooth.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: Always yummy, uncle boss is always friendly. They told me that they close on Tuesday nowadays as well because they (elderly proprietors) are too tired from weekend business.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews:
An excellent bowl of beef noodle.
I ordered a dry version and very satisfied. Slices of beef were tender, and tendons were bouncy and soft enough that you have no problem eating it. Offals had nice texture and I loved them.
Gravy was on a thick side and it sticks to kway teow. Packed with flavor, the gravy stayed thick until I finished the bowl.
Soup was so nice. If possible, I would have a second and pay for it. So much umami in a bowl, and I could feel my body loving the soup so much.
Will definitely come back again.
Uncles were very friendly and helpful. Recommend the $7 one to experience this fantastic bowl to its fullest. In my opinion, tendon is a must.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: Ordered Beef Noodle Soup, excellent beef broth - so flavourful! Lots of love and effort  in the preparations by the chefs 👍

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews:
Bought a bowl bcos the uncle was waving and begging people to buy from their stall. Had bad experience as the prev times as i saw they drop the meat on the floor but they put it back for serving/cooking

Upon settling down to eat at the table i saw that the beef was still red color. So i ask the cook to cook it again. At that point Nobody was patronizing the stall. He starts to say you should have said earlier if you want it to be cooked. Me??? Then their new china staff starts telling me if you want the meat to be cooked even more just press the meat into the soup

She snatches away my chopstick and starts to push the meat into the soup. Like so unhygienic.

Went back to the table to eat. The noodles also dont taste good. Meat like prev genuine review is SCRAPS. Maybe the other reviewer used to eating scraps like dogs. The soup dont balance well either. Super overrated.

This stall used to have long queues but seriously last few years the quality of their service and food really gone down hill

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: 5/10. Beef noodle+soup+chili too bland and not much flavour which leaves a lot to be desire even if the beef noodle is cooked well and tender. I kept hoping for more but alas, that's all it got. Tried twice but not again. Maybe more suitable for elderly or those who like light food.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews:
The soup taste is so “overwhelming” that is smelled and tasted like sewage water. Supposedly fermented shrimp paste is used I suppose but caution to anyone who is trying it for the first time, I initially thought that my fruits are rotten but end up its the smell of the soup.

Got to say that one man’s poison is another man’s delicacy.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews:
I’ve been eating their beef noodles for almost 30 years now and it never disappoints! I love getting the sliced beef and beef stomach dry noodles. That way, you get both the amazing sauce and a side bowl of soup!

The sliced beef and beef stomach are tender. Along with the noodles, salted veg topping and flavorful thick sauce, it’s one of my all-time favourite breakfast/brunch foods to get.

Their chilli packs a lovely punch that pairs well with the noodles. And most of all, the staff are just the friendliest and sweetest. I always enjoy eating here!

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews:
Always a queue during lunch hours. Definitely of the best around in Singapore.  we eat here almost every weekend during school days. My son can't get enough of the beef tripes. The maestro is always serious in his cooking and even at his age the agility and finese in cooking and serving the food is excellent.

Do drop by for a treat if nearby.
Highligh recommended if you are in the hood.  Should eat here at least once.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: This beef noodle is truly unlike the rest . The soul is the differentiating factor.  Must truly try it again!

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: Very generous beef. Soup was super flavourful.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews:
I haven't been here for a few years, actually back to visit and decided to give it a try again to see if it is still Michelin Bib Gourmand standard.
Ordered the mixed one at $7. Wanted the kway teow version but they only displayed thick beehoon and yellow noodles. I asked for the thick beehoon and within 10 seconds they displayed the kway teow and I requested for a change and they happily did the change for me.
Same old same old friendly uncles behind giving me a small talk and being so friendly.
Finally got myself a table and sat down to try the noodles. This time got the dry one which came with a small bowl of soup. The soup is definitely the highlight for me because its so rich in flavour and its slightly different from others because the soup is slightly on the thicker side, like it's loaded with goodness.
The sauce seemed to taste different from before. Not sure if the taste has mellowed a little. The cuts were still alright and the meat was pretty well executed.
Wished they have given a bit of of the preserved vegetables and the miss to me has to be the lack of chinchalok together with the chilli.
Decent bowl of noodles and worth a try.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews:
Ordered a large bowl $7. The kind of comforting food especially a rainy day.

What was surprised me was the concentration of the soup. Ordered at 2pm could be the reason for the broth boiled reduce to this umami savory soup.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: Finally got to savor the beef noodle which a friend recommended. The service is fast and attentive. Beef slices are thin, fresh and tenderly cooked. The bean sprout had good crunch. The broth was thick and flavourful. Refreshing chilli sauce went well with the noodle and beef. Very satisfying meal, would be back to try the soup version

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: mid and soup is too sweet, taste is so average. some of y'all lied in ur reviews lol. no queue at all at 12pm on a friday

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: Wow. This beef noodles is really amazing. Nice balance between savory and sweet on the sauce, tender pieces of beef (including tendon, tripe and sliced beef) and a good solid soup stock. The uncles who run the place have been doing this for years and lovingly prepare each portion. Be prepared for a wait during lunch hour.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: Best noodles ever.  Delicious  sauce and soup. Lovely chilled  out place to enjoy a meal.

Restaurant Name: Hai Nan Xing Zhou Beef Noodle
Reviews: I’ve visited this store for 20 years and it still remains the best bowl of beef noodles in Singapore. The lovely store owners are the best! Be sure to come early because they sell out pretty quick.

Ordered the fried kway teow and was surprised at how much water/broth/soy sauce went into the frying. With no surprise, it was a very wet plate of fried kway teow, and almost too sweet. Unfortunately, we didnt enjoyed it and could only finish 1/3 of the plate.
Order $6 Hokkien mee for lunch. It was so chao tah (burnt) that I cannot finish. This is not wok hey, just burnt food. Do not recommend

Best carrot cake and charkwaytiao I've ever eaten. Believe they added milk in their carrot cake to give the egg a puffy texture. CharKwayTiao is on the sweet side, which perfectly suits my taste bud. The uncle is very friendly as well.
At your own risk.

Occasionally ate there(once or twice a month).

Really getting bad, especially if cooked by the tall guy. Paid for the 5.50 middle option today, the moment I saw my plate I knew its bad.

I know those that stayed in yishun confirm cannot believe it was nominated to be in Michelin bib gourmand. So to those that dont stay in yishun, just dont be fooled, quality is really bad.

Noodles, was not cooked especially the thick bee hoon, hard to swallow.

Broth, freaking watery as seen in the picture, no taste.

Warm noodles, noodles was done within minutes, can clearly tell it was not hot at all, what wok hey, more like chao da leftover sprinkled on it. Raw garlic trapped within the broth.

Egg is non existent, I am sorry if egg is missing, I dk what are you even doing.

To be fair, this store will occasionally be  very good but that is 1 out of 5 times? I am depressed after eating it today, was hoping to eat something nice after work but was given this.

You can’t usually go wrong with it. This outlet doesn’t seem to compare well as compared to the others though.

Would still patronise them because of their branding, when I’m in the mood, but it definitely wouldn’t top my mind especially in the Chong Pang area.
Tried their Char Kway Teow, which I felt was quite good. Had the wok-hei taste,  sweet and aromatic too
Ordered the black carrot cake for breakfast. Not up to standard. Person taking order has short term memory, cannot rem order even after writing down.
Carrot cake taste great at $3/4/5.
是蠻有鑊氣，有多加蛤，整體不錯

Just by the look one can tell it’s not gonna be nice. Didn’t even have a proper broth to enhance the flavour not to mention cover simmer it.
The ingredients were all not fresh and the ratio of beehoon and yellow mee were far off (believe me, I could count the number of yellow I ate).
If you’re not ready to sell then could have just told the customer come back later rather than having customer never coming back again.
Ordered a $10 oyster omelette for takeaway. I don’t know if the chef bad mood or what but it was really bad. The amount of starch and it’s so half cooked

Ordered the $5 fried kway teow for takeaway. It was a letdown. The dish was all kway teow and very little yellow noodle. The kway teow broke apart when picked up with chopsticks. Throw in a few small cockles and lup cheong, other than the sweet taste, there was no wok hey at all. I didn’t even finish half the pack.
Branch tYishun. Only asked for chinese sausage for a $5 plate and they only gives 4 pieces of chinese sausage

Great plate of fried oyster at Chong Pang market. There is a good mix of crispy flour and eggs with a nice amount of fresh oysters. You can definitely taste the wok hei in the dish. Food was served relatively quickly as well. Worth a revisit in the future
Delicious smoky char aroma in char kway teow (炒粿条) and generous pickled radish in fried carrot cake.

My friend bought me the Char Kway Teow and the black carrot cake! I felt so blessed to be able to taste such authentic hawker food in Singapore. The taste brings back my childhood memories! The Char Kway Teow has wok hey taste and it is fried just nice for my palate! The black carrot is one of my favourite dish and I have invested my calories in the right hawker stall! Will
definitely be back again!
Char kway teow ($4 for small + $1.50 for extra hum) - More sweet than savoury, slightly spicy. Wet style. The hums (cockles) were small but fresh. Came with lap cheong (Chinese sausage) slices.

I ordered the Omelette with Fried Oyster ($6). Am I wrong to think that this was Fried oyster omelette (the one with the flour) but instead, it was literally an omelette with oysters.

That aside, I try not to let that ruin my mood but the omelette was making it hard to do so. The top had some parts which were runny (undercooked), but bottom was burnt. And its not like a nce charred, crispy burn but rather a bitter lingering taste. This kind of shows the poor execution of an otherwise simple dish.

Counted about 6-7 oysters, oysters were of varying sizes -some were plump and some were small. They also had some cai po to add to the omelette. My gripe lies in how each component seems so separate from one another, and the final product is far from anything delicious.

Skip the omelette, its likr an amaetur version your child can make for you at home. The omelette itself looks too tame and proper, lacking any strong taste or umami.

(I also just realised that they are a Michelin Bib Gourmand store). Though I probably lack a full picture by not having tasted their prawn mee and char guo tiao, all I can say is that they better be extraordinary cause their omelette was a massive letdown.
What michelin food? Its total mess up food. Hokkien noodle is the worst. Carrot cake still ok CKT average only. This stall is a ripped off for their food quality

This is the original Hai Nan Zai stall, the one that earned the Michelin Bib Gourmand in 2021, which spawned multiple branches after the award.

However, my recent visit in July 2024 was a total letdown. The iconic char kway teow, once bursting with wok hei, now lacked its signature smoky flavour.

While it was still decent, it fell short of the exceptional dish I remembered. Honestly, for the effort taken to queue and wait for this, I feel that it wasn't worthwhile at all because their standards have dropped so much.

It's unfortunate that this quality control issue seems to be a common pitfall for businesses that expand too rapidly. A real pity.

Value: 7/10
Portion is average for $4. 4 piece of blood clams, but very little greens and Chinese sausage.

Well deserve the michelin 2021 amd 2022, big portion for $4.50, however, the staff should know how to speak basic english. They are confused giving out our orders and seems they don't remember who orders it. So make sure you need to pay attention and go and take it. Or they can just give numbers so won't be missed it.
Service is bad. Food is below average. People only buy from this stall when the other stall (more popular and better taste) is closed.
Probably my favorite char kway teow stall in Chong Pang Market.

Came here bc i wanted to visit a MICHELIN BIB GOURMAND hawker.

The black carrot cake $3 is the best carrot cake i ever eaten in my life. My friend who likes hokkien mee also say the hokkien mee is very good.

This stall is great bc they serve the food super fast within minutes and operate till 9pm.
Very good cooking

The mixed black/white order takes longer and it’s a HUGE plate, probably for 3pax!

Got good wok-hei… good amount of burnt crispy parts!!  …..well, at the morning when we ordered.

Should just stick to making tires instead of deceiving people. This is sweet and oily, flat tasting and zero wok hei. If this is what you're looking for in your ckt then sure, knock yourself out.

Ordered 2 packets.
Said will collect later.

Now we re-queue again.
